title: Could AI really end the world?
description:
Jacob Coxon, a 27-year-old AI researcher, quit his job in September 2026 and warned that humanity could be destroyed by the end of the decade. So what does he actually mean? It might not be what you think.

Full episode, Could AI End the World?, on the Tab Twelve channel. Sources are in its description.

#AI #AISafety #ArtificialIntelligence

title: Could AI End the World?
description:
In September 2026, AI researcher Jacob Coxon quit his job at Anthropic and warned that AI could kill us all by the end of the decade. So could it actually happen? This episode looks at the three ways AI could go wrong, losing control, misuse and slow damage, and then at what we could gain if it goes right.

Chapters
00:00 Intro
01:09 The warning signs
03:06 1. Losing control
04:46 2. Misuse
09:03 3. Slow damage
11:22 What could we gain?
